clusters.headline: Colombia: Car bomb attack injures at least 23
aiSummaryBullets: Deutsche Welle reports: Colombia: Car bomb attack injures at least 23
BBC reports: Car bomb tears through Colombian city wounding more than 20

clusters.headline: Armed Men Seize Supermarket And Take Hostages In Cartagena Colombia
aiSummaryBullets: A group of armed, masked individuals seized a supermarket in Cartagena, taking roughly 25 people hostage.
President Abelardo de la Espriella identified the perpetrators as common criminals who fled into the building.
